findings.evidence: grep in the file shows no `γ_apply`/`γ_zero`-style lemma; only `γ_eq_endEquivMatrix` (line 92) and the private `γ_eq_map` (line 254) mention `γ μ`, neither of which evaluates an index.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma γ_zero : γ 0 = γ0 := (rfl)` and the three siblings `γ_one`, `γ_two`, `γ_three`, then drop `γ` from the simp sets at lines 290, 301, 310, 317 and replace the `rfl` conversions at 466–467 with them.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` was removed from `def γ` (correctly, it was unfolding the body), but nothing replaces it: there is no lemma stating `γ 0 = γ0`, …, `γ 3 = γ3`, so the three trace proofs now pass `γ` itself to `simp` (lines 301, 310, 317) to unfold the definition, and line 466 resorts to `have h1 : γ1 = γ 1 := rfl`. The characteristic API of `γ` is missing and the exposed body compensates for it.

findings.evidence: `grep -n 'beamEnergy|targetMass|q2JB|w2JB|xBjJB' EpsilonEridani/` returns only AccessMethods.lean:164-187 (plus an unrelated `beamEnergy` in PVES/Examples/Moller/Basic.lean:107); `w2JB` reads only `d.hadronicMomentum`.
findings.fix: Drop `beamEnergy` and `targetMass` from `JBMethodData` and drop the ignored `_d` parameter from `q2JB` (adjusting `xBjJB`, line 185), or re-add operations that actually read them. If `q2JB` is kept, restate its defining equation as `@[simp] lemma q2JB_def (g_met : Bilin V) (k_out : V) : q2JB g_met k_out = -g_met k_out k_out := (rfl)` instead of leaving consumers to unfold the exposed body — the PR removed `Q2_JB_def_consistent` without replacement.
findings.issue: After this PR deleted `W2_JB_physical_region` (the only consumer of `M_target`/`targetMass`), `JBMethodData.beamEnergy` and `JBMethodData.targetMass` are read by no declaration in the repo, and `q2JB` ignores its `_d : JBMethodData V` argument outright (its value is `-g_met k_out k_out`, identical to `q2Sigma`). The public structure therefore carries data no operation or law uses, so two `JBMethodData` agreeing on everything the API can observe are still unequal.

summary: Two surface problems: `γ` lost its only computation path with no characteristic lemmas to replace it, so proofs now unfold its body by name; and `JBMethodData` is left with two fields and an argument that no declaration consumes after the deleted lemmas.
